oneLineSummary: Recommended stack: (e) libcst codemod + (a) JSON-Schema validation + (c) Makefile dispatcher. One-time libcst CSTTransformer inserts uniform verdict emitter into all 53 scripts at O(1) human cost; Makefile drives weekly CI; jsonschema/fastjsonschema/jsonschema-rs is fail-fast gate. (b) pydantic REJECTED -- existing _patch_verdict_*.py files prove per-script retrofit fails to converge.
rootCause: Empirical: 53 .py / 23 .json -> 57% silent-failure surface. Post-hoc patching pattern already exists in 3 _patch_*.py scripts and has not converged to 100%. Pure post-validation (a alone) leaves 30 missing-output scripts untouched. Pydantic per-script touch cost is exactly what _patch_*.py represents -- known failure mode.
recommendation: libcst (Instagram, supports Py 3.0-3.14) CSTTransformer subclass finds FunctionDef name=='main' or module-tail, appends emission block. Lossless round-trip preserves comments/whitespace. Run once, commit, then CI is pure (a)+(c) steady-state. papermill (d) is secondary if narrative provenance becomes paper artifact (kernel overhead not justified now).
caveats: libcst learning curve. Transformer must handle 4-5 script shapes (main() / __main__ guard / top-level / notebook-converted).
